pr_body:
Unfortunately `ProductFeature.SLM` (which is based on plugin detection) cannot be used reliably on BwC tests, as ILM and SLM plugins were once fused together (and ILM pre-dates SLM).
Introducing an explicit legacy feature instead.

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/103049

review_comment: How does this need to be updated?

It will be removed: the cluster restart tests will be from 8.0.0 onwards, once we have 9.x. 
Now that you ask I'm second guessing this: will it be true?
That's fine, it just needs a comment on it
Ah ok, got it! I will add the comment (to the others as well)

Since most of these features will need to be removed after we move to v9, I have moved the annotation to the class, with an appropriate comment. However, I think it's better if this goes into a separate PR so this one focuses on the fix. What do you think?
